subject: Syndication accelerator: partner listing & co-sell orbit plan
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Syndication accelerator: partner listing & co-sell orbit plan

Team —

CloudForge has signaled they want to push the AWS and GCP syndicated listings in parallel with a co-sell enablement window in Q3. They asked for a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that covers: listing artifacts, co-sell contact handoff, metering/entitlement setup, and a vendor-facing launch readiness checklist.

Quick asks to get momentum this week:
- Ben: can you own the MAP drafts and timeline (publish-ready by Fri)?
- Olga: we will need a checklist of technical evidence (billing screenshots, publisher account metadata, third-party attestations) for AWS/GCP — can you draft?
- Vivek: confirm entitlement/SKU mapping constraints and whether Dedicated SKUs are required for co-sell pricing.

I attached a first-pass MAP skeleton (MAP-draft-v1.docx). I want to loop in CloudForge early — if we can align the timeline and responsibilities we can coordinate publisher onboarding and a joint enablement webinar.

I'll set a short sync with Sara at CloudForge once we have the MAP + evidence checklist.

Thanks,

— Logan
Logan Wright
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Diaz <sara@cloudforge.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Syndication accelerator: partner listing & co-sell orbit plan

Forwarding to Sara so CloudForge can comment inline — see my suggested timeline below.

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Diaz <sara@cloudforge.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & timeline proposal for listing + co-sell (AWS + GCP)

Sara —

Thanks for the initial signal. Draft timeline (high level):
- Week 1 (this week): finalize MAP and evidence checklist (internal)
- Week 2: partner review + sign-off on MAP; start publisher account prep on AWS/GCP
- Week 3-4: submit listing evidence; entitlement/SKU mapping; certification windows
- Week 6: joint enablement webinar + co-sell playbook publish

Risks to call out: metering shim for GCP may need ~2-week engineering lead time; AWS co-sell requires publisher account authority and partner validation.

I attached the MAP skeleton and a short notes doc (MAP-draft-v1.docx). Olga — will need your evidence checklist to itemize what we submit to each marketplace. Vivek — can you confirm if SKU consolidation is possible or if we need distinct SKUs per cloud for partner co-sell reporting?

Best,
Ben

Attachment: MAP-draft-v1.docx
From: Sara Diaz <sara@cloudforge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 14:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP & timeline proposal for listing + co-sell (AWS + GCP)

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear timeline. Quick context from CloudForge:
- We have an active AWS publisher account and will request GCP publisher enrollment this week (should be approved in ~10 business days).
- For co-sell, our AWS partner manager asked us to provide billing/usage samples and entitlement mapping; they also requested the planned go-to-market collateral for partner-led engagements.

Questions for Redwood:
1) Who is the primary publisher contact at Redwood for each cloud (we need a named contact for AWS validation)?
2) Can you share the MAP and your evidence checklist ASAP so our compliance team can start preparing artifacts?

We’re available for a 30-minute alignment call Thu 10–12 ET; let us know what works.

Sara Diaz
Head of Cloud Partnerships | CloudForge Solutions
sara@cloudforge.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Sara Diaz <sara@cloudforge.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & timeline proposal for listing + co-sell (AWS + GCP)

Sara —

Answers inline: 1) Primary publisher contacts: Ben Carter (AWS lead) and Vivek Kulkarni (cross-cloud entitlements). Ben will be the AWS validation contact; I will be the Redwood exec sponsor for the deal.

2) Attaching our MAP skeleton and an evidence checklist template (evidence-checklist.pdf). Olga — pls populate the checklist with the specific artifacts we need to upload for each marketplace (publisher metadata, billing examples, third-party attestations, integration diagrams, security questionnaire excerpts).

Proposed meeting: Thu 09 Jul 2026 at 10:30 ET — 30 minutes. If that works Sara, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Next steps (owner tags):
- Ben: finalize MAP (owner) — due Fri 10 Jul
- Olga: evidence checklist + Drive folder with artifacts (owner) — due Tue 14 Jul
- Vivek: SKU/entitlement mapping note for partner co-sell (owner) — due Tue 14 Jul
- CloudForge: confirm publisher enrollment status and share initial billing samples — due Tue 14 Jul

Thanks — this is a tight window but doable if we keep to owners/dates.

— Logan

Attachment: evidence-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sara Diaz <sara@cloudforge.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & timeline proposal for listing + co-sell (AWS + GCP)

Thanks — quick status update.

I created a Drive folder and uploaded a first-pass evidence matrix (cloudforge-listing-metadata.xlsx) plus a short list of screenshots and security playbook snippets. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bCF_listing_artifacts

Highlights / open items:
- AWS: billing sample OK. Need CloudForge to provide the last 3 months of usage summary (csv).
- GCP: publisher enrollment in progress — once active, we need the publisher ID and org-level billing snapshot; GCP requires an additional certificate for usage-based entitlements (see cell B7 in the matrix).
- Certification: CloudForge’s SOC2 Type II report will cover most requirements — please upload a redacted copy.

I’ve attached the metadata sheet and the checklist. Will keep populating as docs arrive.

Olga Petrov
Senior Catalog Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com
